title: HB2735 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, relative to firearms transactions.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2024-01-31; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 2909479)
provenance.note: Draft dated 2024-01-31 (as filed). No votes recorded. The subsection letter is left blank in the printed bill.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1316, new subsection): (1) A person commits an offense who provides to a gun dealer or private seller of firearms what the person knows to be materially false information with intent to deceive the dealer or seller about the legality of a transfer of a firearm. (2) A person commits an offense who knowingly obtains a firearm for the purpose of transferring the firearm to another who is prohibited from receiving or possessing a firearm by state or federal law. (3) A violation of this subsection ( ) is a Class E felony.
